headline: Israel and Iran engage in direct strikes on critical energy infrastructure and national territories, driving global energy prices and threatening semiconductor supply chains.
summary: The direct military escalation between Israel and Iran, involving attacks on major energy facilities, has caused Brent crude to top $119 per barrel and threatens a critical helium shortage for semiconductor manufacturing. This rapidly intensifying regional conflict will severely disrupt global energy markets, impact manufacturing costs, and destabilize geopolitical alliances worldwide.
